source_standard: AMEC Integrated Evaluation Framework (Barcelona Principles), https://amecorg.com/amecframework/

judgment_methodology.method: Google engineering-practices reviewer standard for what a PR description must justify

planning_methodology.method: Conventional Commits type/scope taxonomy planned before the commit series is written

deliverable_form.method: Keep a Changelog entry (Added/Changed/Fixed/Removed) alongside the commit series

feedback_methodology.method: Conventional Comments labeling (praise/nitpick/issue/question) on review threads

review_methodology.method: SemVer-impact check: does the change require a major/minor/patch bump per its actual API surface delta

degree_level_knowledge.source: Beams, "How to Write a Git Commit Message"; cbea.ms/git-commit

reference_resolution.rule: outcome must trace back to a stated objective on the same record — no orphan outcomes (AMEC's own chain requirement).

recomputation.rule: outcome is recomputed from the current channel's actual measured output, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that `outcome` names a change in awareness/attitude/behavior tied to the record's own `objective`, not restated `output` (volume produced) or `outtake` (what audience recalls/thinks)
quality_bar.verified_source: AMEC, 'Integrated Evaluation Framework' — https://amecorg.com/amecframework/ (primary source; AMEC's own framework defines outputs, outtakes, and outcomes as distinct rungs, with outcome specifically meaning a change resulting from the communication, not a restatement of the lower rungs).

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that no field in the record expresses value as an Advertising Value Equivalency (AVE) figure
quality_bar.verified_source: AMEC, 'Barcelona Principles 3.0' — https://amecorg.com/barcelona-principles-3-0/ (primary source; Principle 2 explicitly states AVEs do not measure communication value and are rejected outright by the standard).

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that `channel` matches the AMEC/PESO definitional test for its declared category (paid = bought placement, earned = third-party coverage, shared = audience-distributed, owned = organization-controlled)
quality_bar.verified_source: AMEC Integrated Evaluation Framework, 'Channel Planning' — https://amecorg.com/amecframework/set-objectives/ (primary source; the framework's own channel taxonomy is the paid/earned/shared/owned split the spec's `required_fields` enum reuses verbatim).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does the record combine quantitative measurement (reach, volume, sentiment score) with qualitative context (what the coverage/response actually said), rather than quantity alone?
quality_bar.verified_source: AMEC, 'Barcelona Principles 3.0', Principle 5 — https://amecorg.com/barcelona-principles-3-0/ (primary source; Principle 5 states that qualitative and quantitative measurement are both important, guarding against a volume-only report).

quality_bar.verification_method: gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

use_when.board_condition: a PR or communications activity concludes AND no pr-communications record exists yet for that activity
